programs.title: Life Below Zero: First Alaskans
programs.desc:
A story about the indigenous people of Alaska who have lived according to the rhythm of nature for centuries.Each season has its own rules here.Tig Strassburg wants to give seven children the knowledge and skills to survive in this hostile place.Young Apassingoks hunt for the entire local community.Joel Jacko combines tradition with modernity.Jody Potts-Joseph, on the other hand, begins a new chapter of life in her home village.Marvin Agnot survives on what he catches in the ocean or finds on the coast.John and Teresa Pingayak are also training the next generation
The second season of stories about the indigenous people of Alaska who have been living according to the rhythm of nature for centuries.Thanks to documentarians, viewers gain insight into a distant world that has its own rules.Cameras accompany tribe members as they face everyday challenges.The filmed characters describe their lives in their own words, expressing, among other things, gratitude for being able to continue the traditions of their ancestors and constantly feeling a bond with nature.At the End of the World Tig Strassburg, known from the first installment of the series, raises seven children with his wife.He wants to give them the knowledge and skills to survive in a hostile place.Viewers will witness, among other things, a joint wolverine hunt.John and Teresa Pingayak are also training the next generation.Together they set off into the tundra.The Apassingoks obtain food for the entire local community.They are just going to sea after a difficult winter.Marvin Agnot also survives on what he catches in the ocean or finds on the coast.Surviving outside civilization requires combining tradition with modernity.This skill allows you, among other things, to hunt effectively and cope with a harsh environment.
